description: Zone-4 โหมดเซียน (Figma 333:6885): STATIC UI (no data, no motion this round — ฟีม), replacing the empty gray ServiceSection('โหมดเซียน'). A big blue habit-card (gradient #B0CFFD→#C6EEF2 + a CSS book-frame [Group 5 = #F9F4F0 rounded-6 rotate -9.15°, NOT an image — proven from design-context] + 2 EXPORTED mascots that overflow/clip the card corners + ซื้อเลย CTA), a 3-card row (3 EXPORTED icons #FF6800/#1D9D9D/#FF0073 on #C9E4F4 cards), and a tertiary CTA. Bug-class the pixels (not the className) own: (1) asset-fidelity — Zone 4 leans entirely on exported assets; a className at a missing file paints nothing (2 mascots + 3 icons must all naturalWidth>0); (2) readability/z — habit-card text + ซื้อเลย (z-1) render ABOVE the clipped big mascot (pointer-events-none), small mascot z-2 over the book only; (3) clickable — both CTAs type=button + hittable (ฟีม: not linked yet, must not submit/throw); (4) no-overflow-x — mascots use %-of-card offsets (−15.24%/34.07%, exact -55px/123px @393) + overflow-clip so nothing drifts/overflows @393/360/320. Phase-0 image-verification OVERTURNED the assumption both mascots came from the 60-char set: the big is a water-rooster in a red robe holding a phone (10_ระกา-น้ำ is the same face but a blue-tie outfit — wrong costume), the small is a leaf/wood sprite (not a zodiac); neither is in mascot/ hero (all dragons) → both EXPORTED to public/images/v2/zone4/ (compressed: sian 1.7MB→121KB, leaf 1.3MB→49KB). Teeth-proven (run-zone4-sian.ts, executed 🟢): 5 imgs paint; ซื้อเลย hit-tested on top; both CTAs type=button+hittable; no overflow @3 widths; mut-asset-missing (a card icon 404s) → asset-fidelity gate → CAUGHT. verify-the-instrument: an injected broken reads naturalWidth 0 (probe not blind). gate_layer=visual (naturalWidth + z-order/hit-test + geometry). Real /v2: Zone 4 renders on the real route (content-proof — cannot exist on the base's empty ServiceSection), Zone 1-3 + Sinse + Pajeu not regressed; the 1 console error is a test-env BE /api/chinese-horoscope 502 (infra, not Zone 4 — home-preview = 0 errors, no zone4 asset failed).
